source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: California’s Chefs Cook Lean, Adapted from Lo's Blueberry Coffee Cake, California Department of Health Services

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 400 °F with the rack in the center.
Whisk 1 egg, 1/2 cup of milk and 1/2 cup of vanilla yogurt in a large bowl.
Whisk in 3 tablespoons of canola oil and 2 teaspoons of lemon peel.
Sift 2 cups of flour and 1/2 cup of sugar onto the liquid ingredients.
Sift 4 teaspoons of baking powder and 1/2 teaspoon of salt onto the liquid.
Stir very lightly with a fork, just until everything is combined.
Gently fold in 1 1/2 cups of blueberries.
Pour the batter into an 8- or 9-inch baking pan coated with nonstick cooking spray.
Mix 3 tablespoons of sugar, 1/4 teaspoon of cinnamon and 1/8 cup of walnuts.
Sprinkle the topping evenly over the batter.
Bake for 30 minutes, until the top is lightly browned.
steps.spoken: Bake for 30 to thirty-five minutes, until the top is lightly browned and a wooden toothpick in the center comes out clean.

steps.instruction: Cool the cake in the pan on a wire rack for at least 10 minutes.
